title: Cranberry Swirl Coffee Cake
description: This beautiful sour cream coffee cake with a cranberry swirl is delicious for breakfast on Thanksgiving day, or to eat while watching the parade!

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.

In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time, then stir in almond extract. Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; stir into the creamed mixture alternately with sour cream.
Pour 1/3 of the batter into the prepared tube pan. Swirl 1/2 of the cranberry sauce into batter. Repeat, ending with batter on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 55 minutes.

video.description: You’ll love how tender, tempting and terrific this coffee cake is for holiday mornings, or really, any morning that beckons your enjoyment of a hot cup of coffee and a sweet slice of cake. Full of pure ingredients: butter, sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder and soda and salt, the secret to the perfect structure and flavor is almond extract and sour cream, and for the pretty fruit center, a can of whole cranberry sauce, layered into a tube pan with the batter. Baked up golden, it’s perfectly sweet and needs no embellishment. Slice away and enjoy with your loved ones!
